summary.method: Regex scan of every release module for top-level theorem/def/abbrev/lemma declarations with their private/noncomputable modifiers, namespace-qualified, compared with exports.json and with fully qualified mentions in Audit/Contracts.lean. This is the human-review obligation the verifier deliberately does not automate; the scan is an aid to that review, not a gate. No instance, structure, class, or opaque declarations exist in the release modules (checked by grep).
